from collections import Counter

def _regular(indices):
    if len(indices) < 2:
        return False
    step = indices[1] - indices[0]
    return step > 0 and all(b - a == step for a, b in zip(indices, indices[1:]))

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    axes = []
    for color in range(10):
        rs = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == color for v in grid[r]) >= 0.65 * w]
        cs = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)) >= 0.65 * h]
        if _regular(rs) and _regular(cs):
            axes.append((len(rs) + len(cs), color, rs, cs))
    if not axes:
        raise ValueError('could not identify regular separator lattice')
    _, line, rs, cs = max(axes)
    rset, cset = set(rs), set(cs)
    ordinary = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                if r not in rset and c not in cset]
    fill = Counter(ordinary).most_common(1)[0][0]
    nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in cs] for r in rs]
    active_r = [i for i, row in enumerate(nodes) if any(v != line for v in row)]
    active_c = [j for j in range(len(cs)) if any(nodes[i][j] != line for i in range(len(rs)))]
    if not active_r or not active_c:
        raise ValueError('no colored lattice markers')
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(active_r), max(active_r), min(active_c), max(active_c)
    out = []
    for i in range(r0, r1):
        row = []
        for j in range(c0, c1):
            corners = (nodes[i][j], nodes[i][j+1], nodes[i+1][j], nodes[i+1][j+1])
            row.append(corners[0] if len(set(corners)) == 1 else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
